summary: Iteration 24 - Complete testing of grouped categories feature. Backend API returns both 'categories' (flat array of 124 items) and 'grouped' (object with Řemesla: 46 items, Služby: 78 items). Frontend shows group headers in Registration, Profile edit, and Customer Dashboard demand creation. Filter/search works across both groups. HTML lang='cs' and notranslate meta tags verified.
